title: Weird Humboldt encounter card (v1, revision 1)
description: Conductor-only authoring contract. Enforced by scripts/validate_weird_humboldt_cards.py (stdlib + PyYAML, no jsonschema dependency; the validator reads its enums from this file). A card file is a YAML list of cards. No Kind Robots runtime, art or ArtJobs are implied.

id.description: Must exist in ENCOUNTER-SEEDS.md. One immutable canonical reality per seed.

revision.description: Saved with every roll so save/reload reproduces the authored text.

tier.description: Provenance tier of the premise, not of each sentence.

cast.description: Fixed authored cast; never mixed at runtime.

canon.description: Facts true in every state, on every roll.

lead_reactions.description: Archetype-specific reactivity: one authored line per active lead.

callbacks.description: Flags later scenes may read. Each must be set by an effect on this card.

by_state.description: Optional (pivotal cards). Voluntary opening/current state lens; the shared options remain the sober-reachable fallback.

target.description: 2d6 + skill + modifier vs target, disclosed before commitment. null only when skill is none.

failure.description: Required when rolled; forbidden when skill is none (no-roll options cannot fail).

check_mods.description: option id -> -1..+1 situational modifier. Sober is always empty; no state may sum above +1.
